kebab_example: aliyun csas create-approval-process --process-name test_process --description '这是一个审批流程' --process-nodes '["example-string"]' --match-schemas DlpSendSchemaId=approval-schema-090134f1ebff0000 DomainWhitelistSchemaId=approval-schema-090134f1ebff0000 DomainBlacklistSchemaId=approval-schema-090134f1ebff0000 PrivateAccessBlockSchemaId=example-string SoftwareBlockSchemaId=approval-schema-090134f1ebff0000 PeripheralBlockSchemaId=approval-schema-090134f1ebff0000 DeviceRegistrationSchemaId=approval-schema-090134f1ebff0000 AppUninstallSchemaId=approval-schema-090134f1ebff0000 EndpointHardeningSchemaId=example-string SoftwareHardeningSchemaId=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApprovalProcess

parameters.help_en: The process name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 流程名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: process_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the approval process. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces. Chinese characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 审批流程描述。长度为 1~128 个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The list of approval nodes. You can define up to 5 approval nodes
parameters.help_zh: 审批节点列表。最多可定义5个审批节点
parameters.name: process_nodes
